QuestInfo.name: Even If You Forget Me
QuestInfo.0: You finally reached Lv. 200. Your days of beating up snails and pigs are long behind you...
QuestInfo.1: I decided to meet Mercedes, even though she probably doesn't remember me. I heard that she's back in Elluel.
QuestInfo.2: As expected, Mercedes didn't remember me. I expected as much, but it still stings.

0.0: Wow, I'm Lv. 200 already? It seems like only yesterday I was beating up bugs and... Ugh, sad thoughts. Never mind.
0.1: I got a message that #rMercedes#k is back in #bElluel#k. I'm sure she doesn't remember me, but... I should go say hello.\r\n#r(You will be moved directly to the map if you accept.)

no.0: Ahh, what's the point in meeting her if she can't remember me? I'll only end up feeling sour.

0.msg: You came to see me? Who are you?

1.msg: I'm... Ah, nobody special. Just a #ewanderer passing by#n, wanting to meet the queen if I could.

2.msg: Oh! In that case, welcome. You seem like a very charming sort... Nicer than other adventurers I've met. Huh, it's strange... I almost feel like I've known you forever.

3.msg: That's... kind of you to say. Really. Anyway, I've done what I came to do here, so I'll be moving on. It was a pleasure to meet you... Mercedes.

4.msg: I... Yes, a pleasure to meet you too. Maybe... Maybe our paths will cross again someday. I hope...
